mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive, but 60-day SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment below 5% signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 5% does not result in positive 20-day SPX returns in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts and retail sales indicate economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS increase, but 20-day SPX returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening cycle, higher FEDFUNDS leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS >4% in tightening cycle, but 20-day SPX returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth signals positive economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not correlate with positive 60-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: CPI exceeding 240 indicates inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL >240 but 20-day SPX returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment and high payroll employment signal a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE low and PAYEMS high, but 20-day SPX returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth in early-cycle expansion leads to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth in early-cycle does not result in positive 60-day SPX returns.
